translations.web: Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
translations.bsb: Still, Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.
translations.kjv: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
